losses.message: Pitches are the written notes; vibrato, arpeggio wavetables and slides are described per instrument.
Pitch bend is not written (use --bend); glides, slides and vibrato are lost.
ADSR envelopes, waveforms, pulse width, ring modulation and sync are not written; each instrument becomes a General MIDI program.
Pitches are the written notes; vibrato, arpeggio wavetables and slides are described per instrument.
ADSR envelopes, waveforms, pulse width, ring modulation, sync, filter and wavetables are not written; each instrument becomes a General MIDI program in the part list.
Pitch bend, glides, slides and vibrato are not written.
Durations are written in ticks without a note type (quarter, eighth); a notation program engraves them from the duration.
A note that crosses a bar line is written as tied notes.
Pitches are the written notes; vibrato, arpeggio wavetables and slides are described per instrument.
Pulse width modulation, ring and sync partners, hard restart settings, level and chip volume changes are not exported; every instrument uses GoatTracker's default hard restart of 2 calls.
Rows are whole multiples of the row length; note starts and ends are moved to the nearest row.

Filter, pulse width modulation, vibrato, slides, level and chip volume changes, wavetable steps (arpeggio is kept as a macro) and the hard restart settings are not exported.
